name: Itagaki Tatsuko
source:
Age: 16-18

The middle child of the Itagaki family and very childish. Her eyes are usually closed, but open when she's serious. Gets distracted easily and likes cute things. Has a huge crush on [url=/c3885]Yamato[/url] since they met due his "Little brother aura".
She is [url=/c9801]Ryuuhei[/url]'s older twin sister. Her name means "Hour of the Dragon".
